representations.A: Course-fitted classifier; course vocabulary and IDF.
representations.B: Course+new classifier; course vocabulary and IDF.
representations.C: Course+new classifier; identical course vocabulary; standard unweighted IDF fitted on course+new training-fold records.
representations.D: Course+new classifier; expanded vocabulary and standard unweighted IDF fitted on course+new training-fold records; retain all course vocabulary terms. Original word12/char25 settings and caps.

weights: Exactly prior recipe: course weight=1; new total mass=200*(course training-fold n/3730), split equally between outlets; within-outlet per-row normalization. Full refit gives every new row weight .1. IDF counts each fitting document once, without classifier sample weights.
scale_policy: Original historical v3 scale fixed; no scale calibration on current validation data.
outer: Exact saved three seed partitions, 3 folds each; event/template dependencies disjoint.
inner: 3 group folds inside EACH outer training part; strata=origin x label. Fit vocabulary/IDF inside each inner training fold. Old external panel may inform inner selection but never classifier/TF-IDF fitting.
policies: Four fixed A-D; independently C-only, threshold-only, C+threshold for each A-D; predeclared primary augmented policy jointly selects B/C/D+C+threshold in inner CV. No outer-based policy switching.
objective: Maximize equal average of new-pool and old-external-panel inner accuracy subject to course>=reference-.005, course NBC recall>=reference-.01, old panel>=reference. Tie: course accuracy, smaller C, threshold nearer -.05, B before C before D. Course-only A uses same internal selection information, but fits labels/features only on course rows.
selection_reference: Per-representation diagnostic policies use A fixed. Primary augmented joint policy must protect BOTH A fixed and equally tuned A joint (take metricwise maximum). No eligible augmented configuration: choose fixed B descriptively and flag no inner eligibility.
full_selection: After all outer policies evaluated, run the same fixed inner search on full approved training pool using the three saved 3-fold partitions. Deployable settings chosen only from this training search, NEVER from development or best outer policy.
gate: Primary augmented outer policy vs A joint: mean course accuracy >= -.005, course NBC recall >= -.01, new accuracy gain on >=2 of 3 partitions, old external mean delta >=0. Report dependency bootstrap intervals; stable new gain requires lower95>0, and also noninferiority checks versus A fixed. All internal/previously-used data; no independent-test claim.
development: After final_selection.json is written: evaluate ONLY equally tuned A and ONE locked augmented candidate on course951/oldexternal306/paired200. Prior fixed scores copied from prior results for context. No dev runner-up or reselection.
promotion: No production/submission replacement and no v4 training this round. A future candidate recommendation requires internal gate plus dev course loss<=.005, course NBC recall loss<=.01, neither external dev accuracy decreasing and at least one increasing versus equally tuned A.
fit_diagnostics: Report course/new in-sample accuracy and corresponding group-held-out accuracy; fixed-threshold C curves; vocabulary sizes and new word/character feature coverage; ROC-AUC, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, each publisher recall and short inputs.
stop: 300 measured user+system CPU seconds total across stages. Training reserves time for export/report; stop and preserve completed outer folds if exhausted; no automatic search extension.
